items.abstract: <jats:p>In this chapter, we provide fundamental principles of higher order neural units (HONUs) and higher order neural networks (HONNs). An essential core of HONNs can be found in higher order weighted combinations or correlations between the input variables. By using some typical examples, this chapter describes how and why higher order combinations or correlations can be effective.</jats:p>
